propositions: close_precheck._completion_precheck incorrectly derives code_root as os.path.dirname(tracker) instead of resolving the explicit/current code repository, causing git log to scan the wrong directory when REBAR_TRACKER_DIR is out-of-worktree
CLI rebar transition ... closed --ref HEAD falsely reports no commit references the ticket when a valid trailer exists in the code worktree but the tracker is located elsewhere
code root derivation must be normalized across _referencing_commits, completion-gate config, and verifier/autoresume repo_root to prevent silent gate bypass or false rejection
resolution must use config.repo_root(repo_root) to respect explicit REBAR_ROOT or cwd Git toplevel, not the LLM snapshot resolver
default in-repo tracker behavior and true missing-commit failures must remain unchanged after the fix
